newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Wembley says don't know why stock active.
newsitem.headline: Wembley says don't know why stock active.

text.p: Malaysia's Wembley Industries Holdings Bhd said there was no material development in the company to explain the stock's recent surge in heavy volume.

"...We are not aware of any reasons, rumours or information that would account for the sudden increase in the price and substantial turnover of the share of the company,' the company said in a late-Tuesday statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.

The stock of the property developer and industrial concern soared in the last few days which dealers attributed to speculative plays. Like Wembley, the stocks of other companies linked to the Bakun dam project also surged.
On Tuesday, Wembley jumped 42 cents or 11.73 percent to 4.00 ringgit on volume of 5.9 million traded.
